scientific_integrity: Proof uses a finite exhaustive state-pair certificate for factor-start parity followed by strong induction; standalone Python performs exact finite checks. Infinite claim rests on induction. Independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the classical binary Rudin–Shapiro word and its bit complement, with zero-based initial factor scan. Not a theorem about arbitrary translated or generalized words. Possible unindexed equivalent literature is a residual originality risk.
title: Exact initial non-repetitive complexity of the Rudin–Shapiro word
